citation.title: a number
citation.text: The number of one unit: one CRM record, or one sentence of a call or a Slack message. Select it to see the source.

quotation.title: a quotation
quotation.text: One whole sentence as recorded. A sentence too long to show is counted, never cut.

record.title: the record
record.text: Typed CRM fields and connector arithmetic. A figure someone said stays with what people said.

role.customer.title: the customer role
role.customer.text: A contact of this account, named by the speaker's Slack profile, the call's attendee list, an alias, the label as a name, or a name variant of a person the attendee list names, the strongest first. The title is that contact's title in the CRM. A Slack author's name is compared with sellers only, so it never makes a customer. A role comes from who the speaker is, never from wording.

role.seller.title: the seller role
role.seller.text: A Salesforce user of the org, or a speaker whose label or Slack author equals a name or ID on the workspace's seller list. An address on one of the company's domains shows the seller side.

role.other_party.title: the other party role
role.other_party.text: A speaker the evidence names who is on neither side: their address is on another organisation's domain, which the line shows. The basis says other party by domain and names it.

role.unknown.title: the unknown role
role.unknown.text: No label, a label that matches nobody, two or more contacts with the name, a name shared by a seller and a contact, or a label over 200 characters. The card does not guess. The line says which.

not_read.title: Not read
not_read.text: What the connector did not read or did not show for this card. A source that was not read is never treated as silence.

guide.label: Working a deal, What flags a deal

seal.title: the seal
seal.text: A card is sealed when it is published: a receipt names the SHA-256 of its bytes. A changed card is refused.

countdown.title: the countdown
countdown.text: Days from the card's date to the renewal date on the record. The line under the number names the record it counts to. Nothing is inferred from the close date.

arr.title: ARR
arr.text: Annual recurring revenue, from the field mapped as recurring revenue. Opportunity amount never stands in for it. If no field is mapped, the card says the value is missing.

ops.coverage.title: Coverage
ops.coverage.text: Which deals have a current card and which do not.

guide.label: Setting it up, The Ops area

ops.receipt.title: the receipt
ops.receipt.text: One row of the audit log. A read gets its receipt before it runs.

ops.activity.title: Activity
ops.activity.text: What ran to make one card: its seal, then each read it rests on, each with its receipt in full. Every source read and every card seal leaves a receipt.

guide.label: Receipts and the audit log, What a receipt holds

receipt.arguments.title: the arguments
receipt.arguments.text: The arguments as the call sent them, kept as stored. They are shown here as text, with every character outside printable ASCII written as an escape.

guide.label: Receipts and the audit log, What a call sent
